payout_quote: Adult Healthy Volunteer Studies Enrolling at Yale: Brain Imaging Research Study - If you are 18-50 years old, and in good general health... Participation would also include completion of blood draws, receiving one dose of a study drug, and 1-2 overnight stays. Compensation between $1,825 - $2,025... Other currently-enrolling studies on the same page: neurofeedback craving study up to $825, brain-imaging genetics study compensation up to $260, stress/sleep/blood-pressure study compensation $400-$700, DMT study up to $750, VR psychedelic study $25.
steps: Open Yale School of Medicine's official 'Adult Healthy Volunteer Studies Enrolling at Yale' hub (medicine.yale.edu) and pick a currently-enrolling study you fit.
Contact the listed study team directly (e.g. for the ITI Brain Imaging Study: call 203-737-7496 or email kayla.cottiers@yale.edu and mention 'ITI Brain Imaging Study').
Complete the study's eligibility screening and pass medical screening.
Complete the full study schedule (e.g. ITI Brain Imaging: PET/CT/MRI scans, blood draws, one dose of a study drug, 1-2 overnight stays).
Receive the study compensation (ITI Brain Imaging: between $1,825 and $2,025 for completing all parts).
catches: You must pass medical screening and meet study-specific criteria (age, health status, BMI); not everyone qualifies.
Studies carry real medical risks and procedures: the brain-imaging study includes PET/CT radiation scans, a lumbar-puncture in another listed study, MRI with contrast, and receiving a study drug.
The representative ITI Brain Imaging study requires 1-2 overnight stays at the clinic plus PET/CT/MRI scan sessions; the $1,825-$2,025 stipend is paid only for completing the full stay(s).
Compensation is a fixed stipend range for full completion ($1,825-$2,025 for the representative study), not wages or guaranteed income.
Some studies are on-campus only at Yale in New Haven/West Haven, CT - travel is your own cost unless noted otherwise.
Individual study availability can change; you must contact the study team to confirm current enrollment.
biggest_catch: This is university medical research: you must pass strict medical screening (not everyone qualifies) and undergo real medical procedures with radiation scans, blood draws, and a study drug - the $1,825-$2,025 is a fixed stipend for full completion, paid only if you qualify and finish.
eligibility: Healthy adults 18+ (age ranges vary by study; ITI Brain Imaging: 18-50 in good general health); must pass study-specific screening.
timing: Compensation is paid for completing the study parts; amounts and payout schedules are confirmed by each study team during enrollment.
